title: Set 272

sentences.ko: 이번 주말에 아무 계획도 안 잡아서 심심하겠다 싶었는데, 솔직히 몇 달 만에 제일 좋은 주말이었어. 일요일엔 집 밖에 한 발짝도 안 나갔다니까.
sentences.text: I didn't make any plans this weekend, and I figured I'd get bored, but honestly it was the best weekend I've had in months. I didn't even leave the house on Sunday.

alts.text: Had zero plans this weekend and figured I'd be bored out of my mind, but honestly? Best weekend I've had in months. Didn't even leave the house Sunday.
I did not make any plans this weekend, and I expected to be bored, but to be honest, it was the best weekend I have had in months. I did not even leave the house on Sunday.

sentences.note: **I figured** 는 그럴 거라고 생각했다는 뜻으로, 말할 때 think 보다 훨씬 자주 씁니다. **the best weekend I've had in months** 는 몇 달 만에 최고였다는 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 허리가 너무 아파서 엄청 비싼 사무용 의자를 하나 샀거든. 근데 알고 보니 책상 밑에 안 들어가. 상자도 벌써 버려서 반품도 못 해.
sentences.text: I bought one of those really expensive office chairs because my back's been killing me, but it turns out it doesn't fit under my desk. And I already threw out the box, so I can't even send it back.

alts.text: My back's been killing me, so I got one of those super pricey office chairs. Turns out it won't fit under my desk. And I already tossed the box, so I can't even return it.

I purchased one of those very expensive office chairs because I have been having severe back pain, but it turns out that it does not fit under my desk. I have also already discarded the box, so I am unable to return it.

sentences.note: **my back's been killing me** 는 허리가 아파 죽겠다는 뜻입니다. **it turns out** 는 알고 보니라는 뜻이고, **send it back** 은 물건을 반품한다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 너희 아들 작년이랑 같은 선생님 됐어? 우리 애는 새로 온 선생님이 됐는데, 선생님은 괜찮은 분이겠지만 애가 친한 친구가 한 명도 같은 반이 안 돼서 첫 주 내내 울었어.
sentences.text: Did your son get the same teacher as last year? Mine got the new one, and I'm sure she's fine, but he cried the whole first week because none of his friends are in his class.

alts.text: Your son get the same teacher as last year? Mine got the new one. I'm sure she's fine, but he bawled the whole first week 'cause none of his friends are in his class.

Was your son assigned the same teacher as last year? My son was assigned the new teacher, and I am sure she is perfectly capable, but he cried throughout the entire first week because none of his friends are in his class.

sentences.note: **Did your son get the same teacher** 처럼 선생님이 배정됐다고 할 때는 get 을 씁니다. **I'm sure she's fine** 은 그 사람한테 문제가 있는 건 아니라고 먼저 말해 둘 때 쓰는 표현입니다.

sentences.ko: 아들한테 같은 책을 세 번이나 읽어 줬는데, 그다음엔 물 달라고 하고, 그다음엔 엄청 중요한 할 말이 있다는 거야. 트럭이 좋대. 그래서 애가 잠들 때쯤엔 너무 지쳐서 그냥 애 방바닥에 드러누워 있었어.
sentences.text: I read my son the same book three times, and then he wanted water, and then he had to tell me something really important, which was that he likes trucks. So by the time he fell asleep, I was so wiped out that I just lay there on his floor.

alts.text: Read him the same book three times, then he wanted water, then he had something super important to tell me. He likes trucks. So by the time he fell asleep, I was so beat I just lay there on his floor.

I read my son the same book three times, after which he asked for water, and then he needed to tell me something very important, which was that he likes trucks. By the time he fell asleep, I was so exhausted that I simply lay down on his floor.

sentences.note: **by the time** 은 ~할 때쯤에는이라는 뜻입니다. **wiped out** 은 완전히 녹초가 됐다는 말이고, casual 의 **beat** 도 같은 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 이사하는 거 정말 도와주고 싶은데, 그 토요일에 언니네 애들 봐 주기로 벌써 약속해서 이제 와서 못 빼. 근데 일요일에 짐 푸는 거 도와줄 사람 필요하면 내가 꼭 갈게.
sentences.text: I'd really love to help you move, but I already promised my sister I'd watch her kids that Saturday, and I can't back out now. If you need help unpacking on Sunday, though, I can totally come over.

alts.text: I'd love to help you move, but I told my sister I'd watch her kids that Saturday and I can't bail on her now. If you want help unpacking Sunday, though, I'm totally there.

I would very much like to help you move, but I have already promised my sister that I would look after her children that Saturday, and I cannot withdraw from that commitment now. However, if you need assistance unpacking on Sunday, I would be glad to come over.

sentences.note: **back out** 은 하기로 한 일에서 빠진다는 뜻이고, casual 의 **bail on her** 도 비슷하게 씁니다. **watch her kids** 는 아이들을 봐 준다는 말입니다.

reviewed: 3번 casual 의 cried all first week 는 원어민이 잘 쓰지 않는 어순이라 cried the whole first week 의 뜻을 살려 bawled the whole first week 로 고침
1번 formal 의 I expected that I would become bored 가 딱딱한 글말이라 뜻은 그대로 두고 I expected to be bored 로 고침
